---
title: gganimate
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(gifski)

anim <- ggplot(mtcars) +
  aes(mpg, disp) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = gear)) +
  transition_states(gear, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1) +
  enter_fade() +
  exit_fade()
```

::: {layout-ncol="2"}
## No `animate()`

```{r}
anim
```

## `animate()`

```{r}
animate(anim)
```
:::
